{{Quote|I was but a boy when the evil Melida invaded Garth and herded my people into camps.|Hologram of [[Micae]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Garth''' occurred at some point during the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]]. The [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] invaded the city of [[Garth (city)|Garth]] and herded the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] there into concentration camps.
